title: Docker Build Executor
description: Executor for building Docker images using Docker CLI.

registry.description: Docker registry base URL. If not provided, the DOCKER_REGISTRY environment variable is used.

context.description: Docker build context. 'dist' is the project's own build output (dist/apps/<project>), for an image whose Dockerfile only copies a finished bundle.

buildArgs.description: Build arguments to pass to the Docker build command

forwardEnv.description: Names of environment variables to forward as build args when they are set (an explicit buildArg of the same name wins). Lets the project pass dynamic values without the executor knowing what they are.

cache.description: Buildx cache backend. Falls back to the DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE env var, then 'local'.

cacheMode.description: Buildx cache export mode. Falls back to DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_MODE, then 'max'.

cacheScope.description: Cache scope/key for the gha backend. Falls back to DOCKER_BUILD_CACHE_SCOPE, then the image name.

pushToRegistry.description: Push the built image to the Docker registry after a successful build

skipLogin.description: Skip login to the Docker registry when pushing. Useful for CI/CD or development environments since the user should already be authenticated.
